title: 🌀 Pseudo-3D Spaces

accepted_baseline.label: Two-map monumental Spaces + fixed frontal camera

current_candidate.summary: Spaces v14 adds direct vertical touch-swipe locomotion on the canvas and disables browser text selection, long-press callouts, context menus and drag selection so mobile controls no longer summon copy/paste UI.

open_feedback: Verify on touch device: swipe finger upward on the scene to advance and downward to retreat.
Verify long-pressing or accidentally dragging over controls no longer selects arrow/button characters or opens copy/paste selection UI.
Preserve v13 lighting, diagonal brutalist layout and current WASD/wheel controls.
